name: Crimson and Connect Empowerment Initiative
tagline: Every child empowered to fulfil their potential.

slides.title: Who We Are
paragraphs: A youth-led organization dedicated to ensuring that every child, regardless of origin, with or without disability, is empowered to fulfil their potential. Built on more than five years of hands-on interventions for in-school and out-of-school children.
No child should be left behind because of poverty, gender, disability or circumstance.

pairs.label: Vision
pairs.text: An Africa where every child and adolescent has access to quality education, the skills to earn a living, and the confidence to lead.

pairs.label: Mission
pairs.text: To reach marginalized children, especially out-of-school children and adolescent girls, with learning, life skills and livelihood opportunities that open real pathways to a better future.

cards.title: Education and Safe Spaces
cards.text: Safe learning spaces through the Crimson and Connect Education Project for out-of-school children and adolescent girls (10–18, with or without disability): basic literacy, numeracy, and life skills including SRHR, mental health and bodily autonomy.

cards.title: Vocational Skills Training
cards.text: The Vocational Skill Centre teaches fashion, baking and digital skills, followed by internship placements for top trainees.

cards.title: Back to School Support
cards.text: School essentials and retention support so vulnerable children enrol and stay in school.

cards.title: Community Advocacy and Health Education
cards.text: Engaging communities, parents and leaders; training peer educators for adolescent health and inclusive learning.

cards.title: Youth Leadership
cards.text: Peer-to-peer workshops and student platforms such as the Fail Fun Conference in Abuja.

slides.title: Our Approach
paragraphs: Individualized learning plans that meet each child where they are, working with parents, community and religious leaders, mentors and partners so change is owned by the community and lasts.

pairs.label: Where we work
pairs.text: Federal Capital Territory (Abuja), including communities in Kwali Area Council, with plans to expand to other states.

pairs.label: Partner with us
pairs.text: We welcome donors, corporate organizations, schools and development agencies who share the belief that every child deserves a chance.

slides.title: Where to Find Us
slides.note: Federal Capital Territory (Abuja), including Kwali Area Council.
